meta.purpose: Structured, append-only record of every review cycle run via the review-web skill. Schema and procedure shared across review-api/review-web/review-infra/review-harness — see .claude/skills/review-shared/PROCEDURE.md.
howToUse: Append a new entry, status 'reviewing', before starting a cycle.
Move through fixing -> re_reviewing -> awaiting_merge_approval as the cycle progresses.
Never set 'merged' yourself unless a human has confirmed the merge actually happened — this skill never runs `gh pr merge`.

statusLegend.re_reviewing: Fixes pushed, re-verifying against the real remote branch.
statusLegend.awaiting_merge_approval: Cycle complete, PR ready, waiting on a human to merge.
statusLegend.no_issues_found: Both passes ran, genuinely nothing to report.

meta.invariantsRef: review-shared/PROCEDURE.md + root AGENTS.md §2 (this domain's harness-compliance checks).

features.title: Review fix/autosave-race-guard before it's PR'd
features.description: Two real, unreviewed, un-PR'd commits sit on branch fix/autosave-race-guard: 9c6e26f (serialize /input PATCHes to close an autosave race — an older transcript PATCH could resolve after a newer one server-side with no version guard, staling the red-flags banner and next generation's Subjective section) and 4b3d024 (seq-gate the mount-time red-flags fetch too, closing a gap an evaluator pass found — mount-time getRedFlags wasn't seq-gated like the edit-triggered one, so a slow initial fetch could clobber a fresher edit-triggered result). Neither has gone through /code-review or this skill's harness-compliance pass yet.
acceptance: /code-review run against the branch/PR at an appropriate effort level.
Harness-compliance pass checks the sequencing/race-guard logic against no relevant AGENTS.md §2 invariant is silently violated (e.g. CONTEXT-INJECTION isn't implicated here, but re-check).
A real PR exists for this work (currently just sits on an un-PR'd branch).
verify: gh pr view <new PR number> --json state
